headline: Sunday on the Lake: Perfect Late-Summer Skies
lede: Sunday, September 13th brings ideal late-summer weather to Branson with highs in the low 80s, plenty of sunshine, and low humidity — the perfect day for first-time visitors to enjoy the lake, a show, or a relaxed meal with a view. Lake levels remain boater-friendly, and the pace is comfortable for families.

featured.title: Lake House Restaurant Spotlight
featured.why: Classic lakeside dining with generous portions, beautiful views, and a welcoming vibe. Ideal for Sunday family meals or a special night out. Representational photo from catalog.

plan.title: Morning on the Water
plan.detail: Start with a peaceful sunrise cruise or breakfast overlooking Table Rock Lake. Coolest hours and lowest crowds make it ideal for photos and relaxed exploration.

plan.title: Shows & Family Fun
plan.detail: Catch a matinee at one of Branson's world-class theaters or head to Silver Dollar City for rides and fall festivities. Plenty of shaded and indoor options available.

plan.title: Lakeside Dinner
plan.detail: End the day with dinner at a lakeside venue as the sun sets over the water. Temperatures stay comfortable well into the evening.

indoor.name: Sight & Sound Theatre
indoor.detail: Spectacular biblical productions in a state-of-the-art theater. Highly recommended for all ages — book ahead for best seats.

indoor.name: Clay Cooper Theatre
indoor.detail: High-energy country music and comedy show perfect for families. Excellent sound and comfortable seating.

indoor.name: Dolly Parton's Stampede
indoor.detail: Dinner theater with horses, music, and a full meal. A Branson classic that delivers consistent fun for first-timers.
